query:
SELECT 
  id,
  title,
  slug,
  discipline,
  JSON_EXTRACT(metadata, '$.director') as director,
  JSON_EXTRACT(metadata, '$.theatre') as theatre,
  JSON_EXTRACT(metadata, '$.creativeTeam') as creativeTeam
FROM projects 
WHERE discipline = 'scenic-design'
LIMIT 3;
